description: Reads the lines of the open DIYA-GL book (every sale, purchase, bank movement, payslip and journal entry, with its entryNumber, journal, account, date, amount, customer, supplier or payee, description, reference and VAT fields), filtered and optionally grouped with a count and a total in pence. Filters combine: journal, account, dates, text and reference. Use this when the person asks who their best customer is, which suppliers cost most, what they spent on something in a month, or for their largest sales or purchases. It does not change the book.

accountMainID.description: The account ids to keep, for example 4000 (the chart tool lists them)

documentReference.description: Text found in the reference, ignoring case

from.description: The earliest date kept, YYYY-MM-DD inclusive

groupBy.description: detailComment (customer or supplier), accountMainID or month (YYYY-MM)

journal.description: The journals to keep: sales, purchases, bank, payroll or journal

text.description: Text found in the customer, supplier or payee, or the description, ignoring case

to.description: The latest date kept, YYYY-MM-DD inclusive

top.description: Keep at most this many groups, or without groupBy the largest lines

name: lines
title: Read a DIYA-GL book's lines
